literal: Within the affliction called poverty, many sorrows having gone will happen.
translation: Within the single affliction called poverty, many other sorrows will come and gather.
modern: வறுமை என்று சொல்லப்படும் ஒரு துன்பத்திற்குள், பல வகையான வேறு துன்பங்களும் தாமாகவே வந்து சேர்ந்து கொள்ளும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how poverty is not just a single hardship but a magnet for many others. The word 'நல்குரவு' means poverty, which is described as an 'இடும்பை' or affliction. Within this one affliction, 'பல்குரைத் துன்பங்கள்' (many kinds of sorrows) will go and occur. This shows that being poor brings about a multitude of secondary sufferings, such as hunger, humiliation, and loss of status.
